The fourth season of Battle for Dream Island was split into two parts. The first part, Battle for B.F.D.I. (BFB), was released on YouTube from November 3, 2017 to March 24, 2020, and the second part, Battle for B.F.B. (also BFB), released on YouTube from April 17, 2020 to April 9, 2021.
Overview
This season revolves around a fictional game show that centers around competitions between 64 anthropomorphic objects divided into 8 teams for a copy of the series's first and second seasons known as "a BFDI", and is hosted by two crudely-drawn integer-like characters called algebraliens named Four and X. Throughout the season, members of the losing teams were voted off by viewers, which affected the course of the season. Viewers suggested their own characters to make cameo appearances, known as recommended characters. At the end of Battle for B.F.D.I., another algebralien, Two, came and split the season in half, taking most of the season's contestants with them. The contestants that stayed with Four competed in the season's second part, Battle for B.F.B., while the contestants that went with Two competed in the new fifth season, Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two.

Announcer reveals that the show is facing cancellation due to a critically low budget (caused by his massive splurging and upgrading of their assets), prompting all the contestants and Purple Face to scramble to raise enough funds to save the show in an abandoned TV studio; they also note Four never ran into budgetary problems unlike the Announcer. Taco becomes suspicious on why the Announcer suddenly returned after the events of "Return of the Hang Glider" and confronts him when he secretly digs up the BFB and BFDI from Four; he reveals to her that after the first season ended, he wanted the show to continue, but struggled to maintain the show while avoiding being noticed by the contestants. After BFDIA ended, the Announcer returned home, until discovering Four and X with the "BFDI". Announcer waited for the cast to shrink before returning and taking back the show and the "BFDI", and had depleted the show's budget on purpose to ensure no one can win the "BFDI" from him. Suddenly, the show's budget begins to rapidly deteriorate, and with it, the style of the animation. The contestants rush to provide funding for the show, and at the last second, Flower donates $50,000 that Announcer had earlier gave her, saving the show. The Announcer begrudgingly allows the show to continue and invites the viewers to vote who should win the two prizes.

| ShortSummary    = An episode of a season in an alternative reality dimension inside Four's mind—including the eliminated contestants from the EXIT—is generated as a coping method, as Four believes that the contestants do not care for him because they favor the Announcer and hate Four's behavior. When he realizes even the false "EXITors" hate him, he snaps the dimension out of existence when they confront him, and leaves the desert. The Announcer holds the final Cake at Stake for Flower and Gelatin. The eliminated contestants have an opinion vote for which contestant in the finale they would like to win the season. Flower wins the season, but she awards the "BFB" to the runner-up Gelatin. Purple Face robs the "BFDI" for not getting respect and conceals it under the seat of the golden bus. The contestants and X pursue Four to reconnect with him while the other contestants try to collect the "BFDI", but agree that the Announcer should hold it when he reveals it is the only remaining preservation of BFDI and BFDIA. The contestants follow Four to the Sun and, after Gelatin berates him for his behavior throughout the season, Four apologizes and they reconnect again. The contestants and the Announcer then prepare an actual party for Four to celebrate his return. Following this, the contestants go their separate ways, with Firey and Leafy in particular going off to build a third Dream Island of their own.
